arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
translation: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent.

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
translation: The strong one is not the one who overcomes people through strength, but the one who controls himself while angry.
Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
The most complete believers in faith are those with the best character.
